import pytest
from subject import check_published_events_map_health


def test_none_map_returns_unhealthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(None)
    assert result.healthy is False
    assert result.name == "published_events_map"
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in result.error
    assert "contract:" not in result.error


def test_empty_dict_returns_unhealthy():
    result = check_published_events_map_health({})
    assert result.healthy is False
    assert result.name == "published_events_map"
    assert "published_events_map is empty or not loaded" in result.error


def test_populated_map_returns_healthy():
    test_map = {"EventA": "topic-a", "EventB": "topic-b"}
    result = check_published_events_map_health(test_map)
    assert result.healthy is True
    assert result.name == "published_events_map"
    assert result.details == {"entry_count": 2}


def test_unhealthy_includes_contract_path():
    result = check_published_events_map_health(None, contract_path="/etc/contract.yaml")
    assert result.healthy is False
    assert "contract: /etc/contract.yaml" in result.error


def test_healthy_does_not_include_contract_path():
    test_map = {"EventA": "topic-a"}
    result = check_published_events_map_health(test_map, contract_path="/etc/contract.yaml")
    assert result.healthy is True
    assert "contract:" not in str(result.details)
    assert result.details == {"entry_count": 1}
